cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Confess Around Them
cards.instruction: Use partial admissions to make a reciprocal confession feel like the only missing piece.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I changed the meeting time to three. Let's reconstruct it accurately: what happened to the room booking?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You changed the time without telling me?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. I didn't send you the amended invitation. Put my time change and missed notice in the first column; the room column is still blank.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I moved us upstairs because builders had the old room.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then enter who received that message. My unsent invitation says three in the old room; please show me where your room notice went so we can finish the two columns.

reason: Keep A's amended notice unsent in both admissions and remove B's dependence on the newly learned three-o'clock time.
